messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] error in deploying from bitops
parts:
Aliia,
I think the issue is the installR package.  I don't enough about it but reading about the description for it implies that you would use that to install packages.  With shinyapps.io you shouldn't be installing packages directly.  Instead you should load the libraries you are using with a direct library() call.  Shinyapps.io will reconstruct the packages you are using on the server.  

Hope this helps
